answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by binding each identity to a stake escrowed in a shared harbor contract, where admission requires proving control of a distinct keypair. Peers then sample attestations like fruit from an orchard, weighting each voucher by stake and cross-checking a walnut-hard proof-of-work seed per epoch to make mass identity creation costly. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
